title: Locked official-test validation, sensitivity, and end-to-end cost for DCTPR

method.name: DCTPR
method.features: L2-normalized concatenation of individually normalized frozen DINOv2-B/14 and DINOv2-L/14 CLS features

cub.selection: first 10 official-test images per class after sorting by numeric image_id

stanford_dogs.selection: for class c, permute official-test indices with numpy default_rng(selection_seed + c), take the first 30, and partition consecutively into three episodes

sensitivity.data: official-train episodes only; no official-test result may select a value

efficiency.scope: feature extraction is shared by all task heads and reported separately from solver latency

interpretation_limits: Official-test results are a locked evaluation, not a new hyperparameter search.
Matched baselines operate on the same frozen DINO feature tensors and are not full legacy-pipeline reproductions.
Support rotations within an episode share images and are not independent samples.
The balanced query marginal is known to all balanced transductive methods.
